subscription-agreement.intro: This Subscription Agreement (the "Agreement") is between Akea HMS LLC, a Texas limited liability company ("Akea"), and the company, hotel owner, management company or other organization that subscribes to the Services (the "Customer"). It is accepted when an authorized representative of the Customer clicks to accept it, signs an order form that refers to it, or first uses the Services for the Customer. The person accepting confirms they have authority to bind the Customer. Capitalized terms not defined here have the meanings in the Terms of Service.
sections: 1. The Services

Akea will make the Akea AI Suite and related apps (the "Services") available to the Customer and its authorized users during the subscription term, in accordance with this Agreement, the applicable order form or in-app plan (the "Order"), and the Services' then-current documentation. Akea may update the Services from time to time and will not materially reduce the core functionality of a paid plan during a paid term.
2. Users and responsibilities

The Customer decides who receives access, which hotels and modules each user can see, and what each user may approve. The Customer is responsible for its users' compliance with the Terms of Service and the Acceptable Use Policy, for all activity under its account, and for promptly removing access for people who leave. The Customer must require two-step sign-in for users with financial, payroll or administrative rights.
3. Customer data

The Customer owns all data it and its users put into the Services ("Customer Data"). Akea processes Customer Data as the Customer's service provider and processor under the Data Processing Addendum, which is part of this Agreement. The Customer is responsible for having the rights, notices and consents needed for Akea to process Customer Data, including information about employees, guests, investors and vendors, and must not upload full Social Security numbers, full bank account or card numbers, health information, or other data the Services are not designed to hold.

The Customer will pay the fees in the Order. Unless the Order says otherwise, fees are billed in advance in U.S. dollars, are due within 30 days of invoice, and are non-cancellable and non-refundable except as this Agreement expressly provides. Late amounts may bear interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the highest rate allowed by law, and Akea may suspend the Services after giving 10 days' written notice of non-payment. Fees exclude taxes; the Customer pays all sales, use, value-added and similar taxes other than taxes on Akea's income. Billing questions: billing@akeahms.com. Akea may change fees for any renewal term with at least 30 days' notice.
5. Term and termination

The subscription term is stated in the Order and renews automatically for successive periods of the same length unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 30 days before the end of the current term. Either party may terminate for material breach not cured within 30 days after written notice. On termination, the Customer's access ends; for 30 days afterwards the Customer may request an export of its Customer Data in a standard format, after which Akea may delete it, except where retention is required by law or the data is in routine backups that are deleted on their normal schedule. The Customer must pay all fees owed up to the termination date.
6. Customer obligations under law

The Customer acknowledges that the Services are tools and that the Customer alone is responsible for: wage-and-hour and employment law compliance (including overtime, meal and rest breaks, final pay, record-keeping and required notices); payroll processing and tax withholding and filing; its books of account, financial statements and tax returns; bank account security, check stock control, check signing and fraud prevention; refunds and guest payment disputes; communications with investors and lenders and compliance with securities laws; and compliance with any license terms for third-party data such as STR. The Product and Professional Disclaimers apply to the Customer.
7. Confidentiality

Each party will protect the other's non-public information that is marked or reasonably understood to be confidential with at least reasonable care, use it only for this Agreement, and disclose it only to people who need it and are bound by similar duties. This does not apply to information that is public through no fault of the recipient, already known to it, independently developed, or rightfully received from a third party. A party may disclose information when required by law after giving the other reasonable notice where allowed.
8. Security

Akea maintains administrative, technical and physical safeguards designed to protect Customer Data, as described in the Data Processing Addendum, including encryption in transit, role-based access controls, row-level data separation between customers, and audit logs for financial and time records. Akea will notify the Customer without undue delay after confirming a security incident affecting Customer Data, as described in the Data Processing Addendum. No system is completely secure, and Akea does not guarantee that unauthorized access will never occur.
9. Availability and support

Akea will use commercially reasonable efforts to keep the Services available, excluding scheduled maintenance, emergency maintenance, and outages caused by third-party providers, the internet, or events beyond Akea's reasonable control. Unless an Order includes a service-level commitment, there is no guaranteed uptime and no service credits. Support is available by email at info@akeahms.com during normal U.S. Central Time business hours.
10. Warranties and disclaimers

Each party warrants that it has the authority to enter into this Agreement. Akea warrants that it will not knowingly introduce malicious code into the Services. The Customer's sole remedy for breach of this warranty is for Akea to correct the problem or, if Akea cannot do so within a reasonable time, to terminate the affected subscription and refund prepaid fees for the remaining term. privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.summary: What personal information we collect, why, who we share it with, and your rights.
privacy-policy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Akea HMS LLC ("Akea," "we," "us") collects, uses, discloses and protects personal information through our website, the Akea AI Suite and our mobile apps (the "Services"). It is written for people in the United States. The Services are not offered outside the United States.
sections: 1. Two roles

For information we collect for our own purposes, such as website visitors, people who contact us, and the account details of people who sign in, we decide how it is used and this policy applies directly.

For information our business customers put into the Services, such as employee schedules and time punches, hotel performance, bills, vendors, investors and bank activity, we act as a service provider (also called a processor) for that customer. The customer controls that information and its own privacy notice applies. If you are an employee, investor, vendor or guest of one of our customers, please send requests about that information to that customer; we will help them respond.
2. Information we collect

- Account and contact information: name, work email, phone, job title, employer, role and permissions, and sign-in settings such as two-step sign-in.
- Information customers enter about their workforce: employee names, contact details, departments, positions, schedules, clock-in and clock-out times, pay type and pay rate, and a hashed time-clock PIN. We do not collect Social Security numbers, biometric identifiers, or precise location.
- Financial and business records: hotel revenue and statistics, vendors, bills, checks, journal entries, bank transactions from statements or bank-data providers, and refund requests. Bank, tax and employer ID numbers are stored only as the last four digits. We do not store full card numbers.
- Content you submit: files, reports, receipts, emails sent to report inboxes, and questions you ask the AI assistant.
- Device and usage information: IP address, browser and device type, pages and features used, dates and times, error logs and security logs.
- Records of legal acceptance: which documents you accepted, the version, the time, your IP address and your browser.
3. How we use it

To provide, maintain and secure the Services; to authenticate users and prevent fraud and abuse; to process our customers' data on their instructions; to provide support; to send service, security and billing messages; to send reports our customers ask us to send; to improve the Services, including through aggregated or de-identified information; to comply with law and enforce our agreements; and to establish, exercise or defend legal claims. We do not use customer data to train AI models, and we do not use it for advertising.
4. How we share it
5. Artificial intelligence

When you use the AI assistant, your question and the data needed to answer it are sent to our AI model provider, which processes it on our behalf to generate a response. Answers are produced automatically, may be wrong, and are not used to make decisions about individuals without human review.
6. Cookies and similar technologies

The Services use only what is needed to work: browser storage that keeps you signed in and remembers settings. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. See our Cookie Policy. Because we do not track you across sites, we treat Global Privacy Control and similar browser signals as satisfied.
7. Retention

We keep account information while the account is active and for a reasonable period afterwards. Customer data is kept for the customer's subscription and then deleted or returned as our agreement with the customer provides, except where the law requires longer retention. Time, payroll, accounting and banking records in the Services are designed to be kept, not deleted, so that customers can meet federal and state record-keeping laws; customers decide how long to keep them. Backups are deleted on a rolling schedule.
8. Security

We use encryption in transit, encrypted storage, role-based access with separation between customers, two-step sign-in, hashed passwords and PINs, password rules that block reuse, and audit logs. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. If a data breach affects your personal information, we will notify you or our customer as required by applicable state and federal law.
9. Your privacy rights

Depending on your state, including California, Texas, Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, Oregon and others with consumer privacy laws, you may have the right to know what personal information we have about you, to access or get a copy of it, to correct it, to delete it, and to opt out of its sale, sharing for targeted advertising, or certain profiling. We do not sell personal information, use it for targeted advertising, or use it for profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects. To make a request, email info@akeahms.com with the subject "Privacy Request". We will verify your identity before acting, and you may use an authorized agent. We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights. If we deny your request, you may appeal by replying to our decision with the subject "Privacy Appeal"; if we deny the appeal you may contact your state Attorney General. Many state laws do not apply to information about employees or business contacts; we will still consider every request.

California residents: in the last 12 months we collected the categories of information in Section 2 (identifiers, professional or employment-related information, commercial information, internet activity, and inferences limited to product use) from the sources described in this policy, for the purposes in Section 3, and disclosed them for business purposes to the recipients in Section 4. We do not knowingly sell or share the information of anyone under 16. Under California's "Shine the Light" law, we do not disclose personal information to third parties for their own direct marketing.
10. Children

The Services are for businesses and are not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13 (or under 16 in states with higher limits). Customers should not enter information about minors except as needed to schedule and pay employees lawfully.
11. Email

Our service and report emails are transactional. Where we send marketing email, it will identify us, include our contact details and an unsubscribe link, and we will honor opt-outs as the CAN-SPAM Act requires.
12. Changes
We may update this policy. We will post the new version with its effective date and, for material changes, notify account holders in the Services or by email.
13. Contact
Akea HMS LLC, Texas, United States. Email info@akeahms.com or call +1-469-253-2467.

dpa.title: Data Processing Addendum
dpa.summary: How we handle customer data as a service provider, and the providers we use.
dpa.intro: This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") forms part of the Subscription Agreement between Akea HMS LLC ("Akea") and the Customer. It applies when Akea processes personal information contained in Customer Data on the Customer's behalf.
sections: 1. Roles and instructions

The Customer is the business (or controller) and Akea is the service provider (or processor) of personal information in Customer Data. Akea will process it only to provide the Services, on the Customer's documented instructions (which include the Agreement and the Customer's use and configuration of the Services), and as required by law. Akea will tell the Customer if it believes an instruction violates law.
2. Service-provider commitments

Akea will not: sell or share the personal information; retain, use or disclose it for any purpose other than the business purposes in the Agreement, or outside the direct business relationship with the Customer; or combine it with personal information from other sources except as the law permits for service providers. Akea will comply with obligations that apply to it under U.S. state privacy laws, give the same level of protection they require, and notify the Customer if it can no longer meet them. The Customer may take reasonable steps to stop and fix unauthorized use.
3. Confidentiality and personnel
Akea limits access to people who need it to provide the Services and who are bound by confidentiality obligations.
4. Security

Akea maintains reasonable safeguards appropriate to the nature of the data, including: encryption of data in transit (TLS) and at rest; logical separation of each customer's data with row-level access rules; role-based permissions and two-step sign-in; hashed passwords and PINs with password rules that block reuse; storing only the last four digits of bank, tax and employer ID numbers; tamper-resistant audit trails for financial entries and time punches; least-privilege access for Akea staff; and backups held by our hosting provider in the United States.
5. Subprocessors

The Customer authorizes Akea to use the following subprocessors, and Akea will impose data-protection terms on each that are at least as protective as this DPA:
- Supabase, Inc.: database, authentication, file storage and server functions (United States, AWS us-east-1).
- Render Services, Inc.: web application hosting (United States).
- Anthropic, PBC: AI model processing for the AI assistant (United States).
- Postmark (ActiveCampaign, LLC): transactional email, when enabled (United States).
- Plaid Inc. or Finicity Corporation (a Mastercard company): bank-data connections, only when the Customer connects a bank (United States).
- Intuit Inc.: QuickBooks Online sync, only when the Customer connects QuickBooks (United States).
- 650 Industries, Inc. (Expo): mobile app builds and delivery of app updates (United States).
Akea will give at least 30 days' notice of a new subprocessor by updating this page or by email. The Customer may object on reasonable data-protection grounds; if the parties cannot resolve it, the Customer may terminate the affected Services and receive a refund of prepaid fees for the remaining term.
6. Security incidents

Akea will notify the Customer without undue delay, and in any event within 72 hours, after confirming a security incident that results in unauthorized access to or acquisition of the Customer's personal information, and will provide information reasonably available to help the Customer meet its own notification duties under state and federal law. Notifying the Customer is not an admission of fault.
7. Assistance and requests

Akea will provide reasonable help, taking into account the nature of the processing, for the Customer to respond to individuals' privacy requests and to complete any required risk assessments. Akea will forward to the Customer any request it receives directly about Customer Data.
8. Return and deletion

When the Agreement ends, Akea will return or delete Customer Data as the Agreement provides, except copies it must keep by law or that are in backups awaiting routine deletion, which remain protected by this DPA.
9. Audits

On written request no more than once a year, Akea will provide information reasonably needed to show compliance with this DPA, such as completed security questionnaires and summaries of its controls. Any on-site audit requires 30 days' notice, must be at the Customer's cost, during business hours, and under confidentiality terms.
10. Data location
Akea stores and processes Customer Data in the United States.
11. Liability
Each party's liability under this DPA is subject to the limitations of liability in the Agreement.

disclaimers.title: Product and Professional Disclaimers
disclaimers.summary: What each part of the software does and does not do, and who is responsible for what.
disclaimers.intro: These disclaimers are part of our Terms of Service and Subscription Agreement. The Akea AI Suite is a software tool. You, and the company you work for, remain responsible for every decision and every filing.
sections: No professional advice

Akea HMS LLC is not a CPA firm, tax preparer, payroll provider, professional employer organization, law firm, bank, money transmitter, investment adviser, broker-dealer or insurance agency. Nothing in the Services, our emails, our support or our website is accounting, tax, legal, employment, investment, insurance or financial advice. Consult qualified professionals licensed in your state.
Accounting and financial reports

Books, journal entries, financial statements, reports, budgets and forecasts are prepared from the information you enter or connect, using the rules you configure. They are not audited, reviewed or compiled by a CPA, may not follow generally accepted accounting principles in every respect, and should be reviewed by your accountant before being used for tax returns, lender reporting, investor reporting or any other purpose. You are responsible for your books of account and for keeping records as the IRS and your state require.
Banking, bill pay and checks

The Services do not hold, move or transmit money. Payments recorded in the Services are records only; payments are made by you through your bank. Bank data from statements or bank-data providers can be delayed, incomplete or wrong; reconcile it to your bank statements. Checks are printed by you on your own check stock; you are responsible for verifying the payee, amount and date before signing, for signing, for securing blank check stock, for using your bank's fraud-prevention services such as Positive Pay, and for reviewing your bank statements promptly. Akea is not responsible for losses from forged, altered, duplicated, lost or misprinted checks or from unauthorized payments.
Time clock, scheduling and payroll hours

The time clock records the times punched; it does not round, and it does not deduct meal breaks automatically. Edits require a reason and are logged with the original times; records cannot be deleted. Overtime estimates follow the federal 40-hour workweek (Monday to Sunday) and the daily overtime rules of California, Alaska and Colorado. They do not calculate meal-and-rest-break premiums, the regular rate of pay including bonuses, shift differentials or tips, local ordinances, predictive-scheduling rules, minor-labor limits, or other state-specific rules. Pay figures are estimates for review, not payroll. The Services do not withhold, pay or file taxes or wages. You are responsible for classifying employees as exempt or non-exempt, paying all wages owed, giving required notices and breaks, and keeping records under the Fair Labor Standards Act and state law.
Employee and personnel information

You decide what employee information to enter and who can see it. Do not enter Social Security numbers, medical information, immigration documents, background-check results or other sensitive personnel records. The Services are not a system for hiring decisions, Form I-9 compliance or benefits administration.
Refunds and guest matters

Refund requests in the Services are an internal approval workflow. Refunds themselves are issued by you through your property-management, payment or banking systems. You are responsible for card-network rules, consumer-protection laws and guest communications.
Investor and capital information

Investor portals, capital-account, distribution and performance information are provided for information only, are unaudited, and may be estimates. They are not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security, and they are not investment advice. Past performance does not predict future results. You are responsible for compliance with federal and state securities laws in any communication with investors or lenders. Personal financial statements are visible only to their owner and are prepared from the information the owner enters.
Market data (STR and others)

Market and competitive-set data is provided by third parties, such as STR, under your company's own license. It may be delayed, revised or inaccurate, it is confidential under that license, and it must not be shared outside the people your license allows. Akea makes no warranty about third-party data.
Artificial intelligence

The AI assistant uses machine-learning models that can be wrong, incomplete or out of date, even when they sound confident. Automatic reading of uploaded reports can also misread figures. Check AI-generated answers and extracted numbers against the source before relying on them. Do not use AI output as the sole basis for decisions about employment, pay, credit, housing or similar matters about a person.
Forecasts and benchmarks

Forecasts, budgets, goals, benchmarks, market comparisons and "what-if" figures are estimates based on assumptions and historical data. Actual results will differ, and you should not rely on them as predictions or guarantees.
Compliance tracking

Permit, license, insurance and document expiry reminders depend on the dates you enter. Reminders may be delayed or not delivered. You remain responsible for renewing permits, licenses and insurance on time.
Availability and data

The Services may be unavailable from time to time, and data can be lost through error or failure. Keep your own exports and backups of records you are required to keep, and keep your source documents.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy
cookie-policy.summary: The only browser storage we use, and why.
cookie-policy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Akea HMS LLC uses cookies and similar technologies on our website and in the Akea AI Suite.
sections: What we use

We use only technologies that are strictly necessary for the Services to work:
- Sign-in storage: when you sign in, your browser keeps your session in local storage so you stay signed in. It is removed when you sign out.
- Settings storage: the app remembers small preferences, such as recent AI assistant questions for the current tab, in session storage, which your browser clears when you close the tab.
We do not use advertising cookies, cross-site tracking, third-party analytics cookies or social-media pixels.
Your choices

Because these technologies are needed to sign in and use the Services, there is no option to turn them off inside the Services. You can clear them through your browser settings at any time; you will then be signed out. If we ever add optional cookies, we will update this policy and ask for your choice first where the law requires it.
Third-party sites
Links to other websites, and sign-in with Google, Microsoft, Apple or LinkedIn, are governed by those companies' own cookie and privacy policies.
Changes and contact
We may update this policy and will post the new version here with its effective date. Questions: info@akeahms.com.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.summary: Our commitment to making the Services usable by everyone.
accessibility.intro: Akea HMS LLC wants the Akea AI Suite, our website and our apps to be usable by everyone, including people with disabilities.
sections: Our approach

We design to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA as our target. That includes keyboard navigation, visible focus, labels for form fields and controls, text alternatives for meaningful images, sufficient color contrast, support for browser zoom and screen readers, and respect for reduced-motion settings.
Known limitations

Some content comes from third parties or from files you upload, such as PDF reports and printed checks, and may not be fully accessible. Some charts do not yet have a full text alternative; most figures are also available in tables or exports. We are working to improve these areas.
Feedback and help

If you have trouble using any part of the Services, contact info@akeahms.com or call +1-469-253-2467. Tell us the page and the problem, and we will try to provide the information in another way and fix the issue. We aim to respond within five business days.
